fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the use of Replace.exe which can be used to replace file with another file
fields.name: Replace.exe Usage
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\replace.exe" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "-a" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/a" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "–a" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "—a" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "―a")))
